name: yaml-driven-pipeline-executor
description: executePipeline() must stay YAML-driven: phase order, artifacts, mail hooks, verdict parsing, retryWith loops, and sandbox overrides come from WorkflowConfig, not hardcoded phase names. Epic workflows run taskPhases per child bead then finalPhases once; resume skips beads already committed (parseCompletedTaskIds on git log). Finalize drift contracts—target ref unchanged after QA means Test Validation SKIPPED, drift means validation must rerun—are runtime-enforced in the executor, not prompt-only.
